entities.title: Scripts
entities.summary: The contact-sheet renderer: every sample screen drawn headless into one PNG for review.
entities.purpose: Draws each of test/samples.ts's worst-case screens on a ZXScreen, twice side by side (FLASH off and on) with its name above, and writes them as one PNG, without a browser. The UI design and the visual review read the result.
boundaries: Uses the samples the layout tests use, so the sheet shows what the tests check.
A development tool: nothing here is deployed.
